The '''militants fatality reports''' are the official reports and [[War Logs|battle logs]] gathered and published by the [[Ministry of Defence Pakistan|Ministry of Defence]] on the accounts of the rate of human casualties suffered by the [[Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan|Taliban]] in the [[War in North-West Pakistan|frontier war]] since 2005. Reports are based on the official [[Inter-Services Public Relations|ISPR]] accounts and [[News channels in Pakistan|news media]] sources in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and FATA.

This article incorporates yearly numbers of militant fatalities. Details on the numbers of killed in some major battles and operations are also provided.

==Totals==
At least 28,907 militants (total casualties: 43,346+<ref name="KP">{{cite web|url=http://www.satp.org/satporgtp/countries/pakistan/nwfp/index.html|title=Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Assessment - 2017|website=South Asia Terrorism Portal|access-date=24 November 2017}}</ref><ref name="FATA">{{cite web|url=http://www.satp.org/satporgtp/countries/pakistan/Waziristan/index.html|title=FATA Assessment - 2017|website=South Asia Terrorism Portal|access-date=24 November 2017}}</ref><ref name="Region Wise 2017"/><ref name="Region Wise 2018"/><ref name="Pakistani military kills 4 Taliban fighters, after terrorist attack">{{Cite web|url=http://www.cnn.com/2014/12/19/world/asia/pakistan-taliban-deaths/index.html?hpt=hp_c2|title = Pakistani army targets militants after Taliban school massacre|website = [[CNN]]|date = 19 December 2014}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://satp.org/datasheet-terrorist-attack/fatalities/pakistan-fata|title=datasheet-terrorist-attack-fatalities|website=satp.org|access-date=2019-04-18}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://satp.org/datasheet-terrorist-attack/fatalities/pakistan-khyberpakhtunkhwa|title=datasheet-terrorist-attack-fatalities|website=satp.org|access-date=2019-04-18}}</ref>) have been reportedly killed so far (from January 2005 to present).<ref name=toll>{{cite news|title=49,000 Pakistanis have been killed since the war on terror began in 2001|url=http://tribune.com.pk/story/542287/49000-pakistanis-have-been-killed-since-the-war-on-terror-began-in-2001/|access-date=30 April 2013|newspaper=The Express Tribune|date=30 April 2013}}</ref> This figure was updated, adding those counted by the South Asia Terrorism Portal but only concerning FATA and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and not the whole regions of the country.<ref name="KP"/><ref name="FATA"/><ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />
